newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks forfeit early gains to end lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks forfeit early gains to end lower.

text.p: Tokyo stocks settled lower on Thursday, forefeiting the gains they made earlier when they were inspired by the New York Dow Industrials' rise to a record high overnight.
Brokers said activity was quiet across the board and that profit-taking eroded the Tokyo market's key Nikkei average.

The 225-issue Nikkei average was down 167.10 points or 0.78 percent at 21,331.50 after rising to 21,548.21. In the futures market, the benchmark December futures contract was down 200 points at 21,310.
"The Dow's rise propped up the market for a while, but apart from that, direction-giving factors were few," said Harushige Kobayashi, deputy general manager at Yamaichi Securities.
